function.name: lookup_patient_by_phone
function.description: Check whether a patient already exists with this phone number. Call this as soon as you have the caller's ten-digit phone number, before collecting anything else. If it returns found, offer to update the existing record instead of creating a new one.

phone_number.description: Ten digits, no punctuation or country code. Example: 4155550132

function.name: save_patient
function.description: Create a new patient record. Call this only after the caller has confirmed the read-back of their details. If the result says invalid, re-ask the caller for only the fields listed in invalid_fields, then call this again.

last_name.description: Family name, spelled back to the caller for confirmation.

date_of_birth.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Convert what the caller said, e.g. 'March third nineteen ninety' becomes 1990-03-03. Cannot be in the future.

sex.description: Exactly one of the four values. Always ask, never infer.

address_line_2.description: Apartment, suite, or unit. Omit if not given.

state.description: Two-letter US state code, uppercase. Example: TX

preferred_language.description: Optional. Defaults to English if omitted.

function.name: update_patient
function.description: Update an existing patient record. Use this when lookup_patient_by_phone found a match and the caller agreed to update. Send patient_id plus only the fields that are changing.
